scope.title: Comfort station structural steel framing (05 12 00; S2.1, S4.1, S4.2)
scope.text: Fabricate, hot-dip galvanize, shop prime and erect the comfort station steel: 3 moment frames on grids 1, 2 and 3 (6 W12x26 columns and 3 W12x26 beams with CJP beam-to-column connections), 1" base plates with (4) 3/4" F1554 Gr 36 anchor bolts per column (bolts supplied to GC for setting), and 12 HSS 5x3x1/4 roof purlins at 44" o.c. with shear tabs and clips.

scope.title: Steel roof deck (05 31 00; 4/S4.1)
scope.text: Furnish and install approx. 1,000 SF of 1-1/2" Verco HSB-36, 20 ga, G60 galvanized roof deck with #10 self-drilling screws and button-punched seams, L3x3x3/16 reinforcement at roof-hatch openings, and continuous 1/4" bent-plate deck-edge support (approx. 128 LF).

scope.title: Submittals and compliance
scope.text: Stamped structural shop drawings and erection plan, deck product data, galvanizing certification, L&I Intents/Affidavits, certified payroll and apprenticeship-hour reporting.

exclusions: All site metals, furnishings, benches, bike racks, trash receptacles, bollards, dog waste stations, basketball posts, fencing, and signage (excluded from this trade scope).
Light-gauge cold-formed framing (05 40 00), sheet-metal awning/gutter and edge flashing, roof hatch, doors and hardware, field finish painting (09 90 00).
Concrete footings, grade beams and slabs (anchor bolts supplied only), special inspection and testing (Owner), survey and layout control, permits.
Performance & payment bond (add 1.5% if required), Washington retail sales tax (collected by prime per WAC 458-20-171).
assumptions: Comfort station steel quantities scaled from S2.1 (1/4"=1'-0"): 34'-0" x 22'-0" grid, columns ≈10.5' avg; W12x26 assumed for columns and beams per roof framing plan labels.
Steel roof deck installed by S&S per 05 31 00; deck-edge cantilever design by deck supplier (included).

release.note: Budget pricing accepted for submission to A-1 while supplier RFQs are pending (S&S decision required).
